text: URGENT URGENT no hot water and no heating at all since this morning, I have a baby in the house, this is unacceptable, I have called three times. 14b Alder Court. Please someone call me TONIGHT.
notes: Client message 2. No heating in the October-April window is a rule emergency (D6). No hot water and no heating are one boiler fault, so one issue. Baby = vulnerability. Client gave only 'Fri 19:15'; a January Friday was chosen because Dawn says boilers go in winter. If this arrived in June-September it would not be a rule emergency and the label would be Urgent.
